summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., as depositor, filed a Form 8-K for Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2022-L8, an ABS issuer. The filing reports that Green Loan Services LLC was appointed special servicer for the 26 Broadway mortgage loan combination under the BWAY 2022-26BW securitization, replacing KeyBank National Association, at the direction of the directing certificateholder. The change affects servicing only when the loan becomes specially serviced. This is a routine administrative servicing appointment, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic actions are involved. The filing is procedural under Item 8.01, with no impact on securities holders beyond routine servicing continuity.
